DemoDatasetTest.pins: checks on the published demo dataset (light sheet cell images, see demos/demo_light_sheet_cell_data_downloader.m). They are skipped unless the environment variable PETAKIT5D_DEMO_DATA points to the PetaKit5D_demo_cell_image_dataset folder (or its parent), e.g. in Jenkins. The dataset is only read; outputs go to temporary folders. Needs ~16 GB RAM for 100-slice tiles (more for the 500-slice ones).

omwDeconvolutionOnCPU.pins: OMW decon as in demos/demo_RL_deconvolution.m, on the CPU
